summary.text: Nancy Gassett is the Republican candidate for the Vermont House of Representatives, Windham-1 District, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She ran for the same seat in 2022, receiving 690 votes (34.0%) against incumbent Sara Coffey, and in 2024, receiving 1,092 votes (42.4%) against Zon Eastes.
